newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain growth to exceed 3.0 pct in Q2 - Aznar.
newsitem.headline: Spain growth to exceed 3.0 pct in Q2 - Aznar.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar reiterated on Wednesday that Spain's gross domestic product (GDP) would exceed 3.0 percent in the second quarter of 1997.

"Our rate of growth is increasing steadily and all indicators suggest that in the second quarter we shall exceed a growth of three percent," Aznar said in his opening speech in a debate on the state of the nation.
He added that domestic demand was supporting growth more and more.
Aznar told a press conference on Sunday that GDP would grow by more than three percent in the second quarter.
